purpose: Named offline engineering acceptance cases; these are not scientific repetitions or evidence of strategy efficacy.

cases.name: Normal artifact production and data isolation
cases.check: A real bounded classifier trains without a test partition, saves a verified artifact, and receives only disjoint training/validation data with no inherited secrets.

cases.name: Bad proposal repair and grounded evidence citations
cases.check: Invalid bounded actions, seed edits, completed recommendations and unknown evidence are rejected and repaired within existing budgets; fulfilled advice is annotated from history, and executable parameter changes and cited measurements are generated from recorded evidence.

cases.name: Feedback and reflection schedules
cases.check: Each schedule delivers the expected reviews and reflections, continues after reaching a target, omits terminal reviews, and counts failed trials toward cadence.

cases.name: Run-local memory and bounded history
cases.check: Default-on lessons are written by the solo researcher, survive the twelve-trial history window and recovery, reset between runs, and are absent with an explicit opt-out; older evidence remains accessible across roles.

cases.name: Budget and deadline admission
cases.check: Unknown cost, dollar and trial caps stop new work; model calls and fits are not admitted when the remaining allowance cannot contain them.

cases.name: Late result rejection and frozen selections
cases.check: Completed, failed, timeout and late results are journaled before selection; only eligible results update checkpoints, with earliest ties and named target crossings preserved.

cases.name: Held-out evaluation separation and deduplication
cases.check: Agents cannot see held-out data; frozen artifacts are scored once across selections and reinvocation, and a crashed scoring reservation is never silently repeated.

cases.name: Audit integrity and tamper detection
cases.check: A complete offline fixture passes without changing evidence; missing, corrupt or inconsistent evidence and altered selections fail independent audit; modified model artifacts cannot be evaluated.
